mainText: Good morning. Futures are rebounding after last week's drop. The Dow is up about nine tenths of a percent, the S and P 500 up about six tenths, and the Nasdaq 100 up about half a percent. Oil fell about 3 percent on comments about Iran, and October inflation data is due tomorrow morning. The 10 year Treasury yield is about 4.86 percent, roughly flat. Biggest premarket movers: Nvidia down 5 to 6 percent on a board probe of CEO Jensen Huang. Vir Biotechnology up 15 percent after meeting a Phase 3 endpoint. C K X up 52 percent on a one billion dollar commitment and a 10 dollar 13 cent special dividend. Z U R A down 69 percent after a Phase 2 failure. CoreWeave, I R E N, and Nebius all lower on A I cloud pressure. Ionis down about 16 percent despite an earnings beat.
